scope: Independent source-only review of the uncommitted third-round decoder candidate; runtime quality gates remain pending.

resolved_findings.description: Remote Serde inherent deserialize calls bypassed the object-only trait wrapper. Both callbacks now explicitly dispatch through Deserialize; the narrow fix restores nested observation and CapturedField object boundaries.

observations: GetterObservation has the explicit T: Deserialize bound required by deserialize_with; Serialize bounds remain native.
No unsafe code, panic-based production paths, process spawning, suppressed warnings, or new dependencies were introduced by this source.
The object-only adapter and remote derive pattern match existing android_tools wire decoding. Reusing CapturedField and FactsUnavailable keeps capability errors consistent.

The project catalogue retains order while BTreeMap lookup validates duplicate identity, root/module consistency, parent membership and exact caller model/selection binding; this is raw transport rather than imported-name/facet policy.

The existing 28 test expectations remain; the positional loop now supplies useful failure diagnostics. Two additional regressions cover nullable/bool observation arrays and unavailable failure payload arrays. There are 30 authored tests and no ignored tests in this suite.

All six retained complete supplementary helper sources match manifest size and SHA-256 and preserve original Apache headers; NOTICE and LICENSE-APACHE are retained. Canonical original-test credit remains zero.

Workspace Clippy style lints are allowed, so existing nested validation branches are not an inferred strict-lint failure. No concrete redundant_clone, dbg_macro, todo or disallowed-method issue was found.
The bridge task-graph readiness change and late-configuration oracle are source-reviewed only; real Gradle timing behavior requires the owner runtime gate.
